This small plot near my home is where I grow my enset and some coffee trees mixed with a few banana plants. I cannot afford to buy fertilizer from the shop, but I carry manure from my cattle and kitchen ash to the plot whenever I can. The seedlings I use are suckers from my own plants and from my neighbors, the way we have always done here in our area. I do not have a pump or canal, so I depend on the rains, and the work is done by me and my wife with some help from the children after school.
